name: vulkan-headers
description: Official Vulkan C/C++ header files and API registry (XML spec used to generate loaders/validation layers). Header-only, no compiled library; used at build time by Vulkan-consuming projects such as wlroots' experimental Vulkan renderer and glslang.
build: cmake -G Ninja -S Vulkan-Headers-vulkan-sdk-1.4.357 -B Vulkan-Headers-vulkan-sdk-1.4.357/build -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$PREFIX" -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
